title: enumerate()
description: Replaces the manual counter and the `range(len(...))` anti-pattern. Lazy: it does not build a list.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: First index value — use 1 for human-facing numbering.

examples.title: Human numbering
examples.code: for i, task in enumerate(['write', 'test'], start=1):\n    print(f'{i}. {task}')

real_world_usage: Numbered output, reporting the line number of a bad record while parsing a file, progress reporting.

common_mistakes.fix: Iterate directly, or use enumerate when you need the index too.

common_mistakes.mistake: Forgetting `start=1` and printing a task list from 0

performance_notes: Constant memory — it is a lazy iterator, not a list.
